version: LOCK 63 V1 (9 Nov 2026) - side mission: A stranger with nowhere to sleep
builds_on: LOCK 34 runner; LOCK 3 and LOCK 6 regulars; River Market places (LOCK 1). Each mission is its own LOCK and queue line.

missions.title: A stranger with nowhere to sleep
missions.kicker: River Market · A stranger with nowhere to sleep
missions.button: A traveller is sitting outside the inn

a.text: A traveller called Tamim sits outside the inn with his bundle. He arrived too late, the inn is full, and he has no coins anyway. It is getting cold.

choices.label: Pay the stable for a straw bed · 2 coins

share.text: You give Tamim your blanket and take the floor. He talks about the sea until you both fall asleep.

stable.text: The stable boy makes Tamim a bed of clean straw. He thanks you three times.

bed.text: In the morning Tamim is gone. Someone else must have taken him in.

hosted: Took in a stranger for the night
